ros_sacristan.text: Brittany has a saint for everything, and most of them came from Wales, Cornwall and Ireland: Samson, Malo, Brieuc, Pol Aurélien, who gave his name to Saint-Pol-de-Léon next door. The saints sailed over with the Britons.
Every summer the parishes hold their pardons: a procession with banners and the saint's statue, Mass, and then a fair. Repentance first, crêpes after.
